meta_description: Explore an interactive map. Search places, compare basemaps and measure distances or areas.
search_unavailable: Search is unavailable right now. Please try again.
legend_empty: Turn on layers to view their legend.
measurement_hint: Click the map to start measuring.
layer_failed_badge: Failed to load. Turn the layer off and on to retry.
error_boundary_not_found_message: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.
error_boundary_generic_message: An unexpected error occurred. Reloading the page usually fixes it.
webmcp_list_layers_description: List this map's layers, each with its id, label, and whether it's currently visible.
webmcp_list_layers_empty: This map has no layers available.
webmcp_toggle_layer_description: Show or hide a map layer by id. Call list-map-layers first to find valid ids.
webmcp_toggle_layer_input_layer_id: The layer's id, as returned by list-map-layers.
webmcp_toggle_layer_unknown: No layer with id "{layerId}". Call list-map-layers to see valid ids.
webmcp_search_location_description: Search for a place by name and fly the map to the best match.
webmcp_search_location_input_query: Free-text place name to search for.
webmcp_set_theme_description: Set the app's colour theme: system, light or dark.
webmcp_set_theme_input_theme: One of system, light or dark.
webmcp_measure_distance_description: Measure a straight-line distance along named places and plot it on the map.
webmcp_measure_distance_input_locations: Place names in path order, with at least two locations.
webmcp_measure_distance_too_few: Provide at least two locations to measure a distance.
webmcp_measure_area_description: Measure the area enclosed by named places and plot it on the map.
webmcp_measure_area_input_locations: Place names in outline order, with at least three locations.
webmcp_measure_area_too_few: Provide at least three locations to measure an area.
